subject: Stratox Solutions — procurement path & PO lane for AWS/Azure/GCP listings
messages:
From: Lauren Perez <lauren.perez@stratox.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@stratox.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace onboarding — procurement/PO questions

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our procurement team is ready to start the paperwork for marketplace listing on AWS/Azure/GCP. Before we kick off, can you confirm the required artifacts and the PO flow for a standard seller activation? Specifically:

- Which entity name and tax docs do you require for the payor routing? (W-9 vs W-8BEN)
- Do you accept one consolidated PO per quarter or are monthly POs preferred for marketplace billing?
- Where should we upload SOC2 / encryption attestations and the SOW that references marketplace billing terms?

I've attached a quick SOC2 summary and our W-9 for reference. Happy to route our procurement lead if easier.

Thanks,
Lauren Perez
Head of Finance Operations
Stratox Solutions
attachments: 2 (Stratox_SOC2-summary.pdf, Stratox_W9.pdf)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Lauren Perez <lauren.perez@stratox.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding — procurement/PO questions

Hi Lauren — welcome! Quick answers + next steps below.

Required artifacts
- Legal entity + tax docs: W-9 (US entity) or W-8BEN (non-US). We need the document to match the billing entity on your HubSpot seller record.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 summary is fine to start; we require either full report or AICPA letter for activation on dedicated channels (we can accept a summary for hosted listing).
- SOW / contract: attach SOW referencing marketplace pricing or a Link to DocuSign purchase terms.

PO flow options (pick one):
1) Consolidated quarterly PO — vendor issues one invoice per quarter to cloud marketplace; Redwood invoices marketplace as per route.
2) Monthly PO + invoice — recommended for first 90 days to speed reconciliation.

Upload locations
- Attach SOC2 and tax docs to our secure Drive intake folder (link below) OR send them to marketplace-ops@redwood.ai if you prefer DocuSign envelope.

Action items for Stratox (please):
- Confirm billing entity and preferred PO cadence
- Upload final W-9 and SOC2 report (or grant Drive access)
- Sign the marketplace SOW (we can send DocuSign)

I'll loop in Vanessa from Marketplace Ops to validate the onboarding checklist and Olga from Legal for any tax anomalies.

Best,
Markus
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-10-29T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding — procurement/PO questions

Hi Lauren — Vanessa here from Marketplace Ops. Brief operational checklist to keep this moving (I've set expected SLAs in parentheses):

1) Confirm billing entity + upload W-9 (48h)
2) Upload SOC2 report or AICPA letter (3 business days)
3) Fill marketplace intake form (link) and include bank wiring details for payor mapping (24h)
4) Decide PO cadence (monthly recommended for first 90 days)
5) Sign SOW (DocuSign) — we'll attach marketplace-specific appendix for AWS/Azure/GCP billing routing (2 business days)

Notes on cloud-specific items:
- AWS Marketplace: requires exact SKU mapping and net terms confirmation; purchase order should reference the SKU id or publisher account.
- Azure Marketplace: we need publisher GUID and VAT evidence if EU-based taxation applies.
- GCP Marketplace: usually consolidated invoice via partner billing — provide partner account alias.

I'll start a HubSpot ticket and upload a starter evidence binder for you to populate. Can you confirm who from Stratox will own uploads?

Thanks!
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

- Billing entity: Stratox Solutions, Inc. (US) — W-9 uploaded to the Drive link you sent.
- SOC2: summary attached earlier; full report scheduled for upload tomorrow.
- Owner for uploads: procurement@stratox.com (cc'ed) will handle the Drive uploads and complete the intake form.

Two clarifying questions:
1) For AWS SKU mapping, will you provide the SKU IDs or do we submit product listing draft first?
2) For marketplace invoicing, is Redwood the payee on invoices we issue to AWS/Azure/GCP, or do we invoice the cloud marketplace directly?

Appreciate the clarity — procurement@ will take it from here.

Best,
Lauren

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding — procurement/PO questions

Hi procurement team — Kimberly from Finance here. Short answers to your two questions and a mutual action plan.

Answers
- SKU mapping: Redwood provides the SKU template and assigns SKU IDs during listing verification. Please submit the product listing draft; we will return SKU IDs once the listing metadata is validated.
- Invoicing: For AWS and Azure marketplaces we normally invoice the cloud marketplace (they pay Redwood, and Redwood remits to the vendor per marketplace settlement). For GCP partner billed listings, you may invoice Redwood directly; we'll confirm per listing. We'll add exact payee instructions to the SOW appendix.

Mutual action plan (owner / ETA)
- Stratox: upload final W-9 + SOC2 report (procurement@stratox.com) / ETA: 2026-11-02
- Redwood Marketplace Ops: create evidence binder and starter SKU template (vanessa_ortiz) / ETA: 2026-11-03
- Redwood Finance: prepare payor routing appendix (kimberly_park) / ETA: 2026-11-04
- Legal: final review of SOW appendix and marketplace terms (olga_petrov) / ETA: 2026-11-05

Please confirm the dates or propose alternatives. Once uploads are complete we'll schedule a 30-minute intake call to walk the SKU template and payment appendix.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Stratox live.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Marketplace Finance, Redwood Inference
